# SolPrompter

> SolPrompter is a free browser-based AI teleprompter for creators, educators, presenters and teams. It combines AI Voice Scroll, Notch Mode, remote control, script management and Full HD or 4K video recording in one web application.

SolPrompter runs in modern web browsers without requiring installation. Camera, microphone, voice-scrolling and recording capabilities depend on the user's browser, device support and permissions.

SolPrompter is currently free to use, without advertisements or a branded video watermark. Refer to the privacy policy for current details about accounts, local storage, cloud services and data processing.

## Product

- [SolPrompter home](https://solprompter.com/): Product overview, key features and access to the online teleprompter.
- [Teleprompter guide](https://solprompter.com/teleprompter-guide): Step-by-step instructions for adding a script, choosing a scrolling mode, adjusting the reading view, using Notch Mode, connecting a remote and recording video.
- [About SolPrompter](https://solprompter.com/about): Product mission, intended users, design principles and feature overview.
- [Plans and billing](https://solprompter.com/billing): Current plan and billing information.
